title: Written Denial of an Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) Coverage
content:
On an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** claim, Tidemark denies an excess coverage in writing with one denial reason:

| Denial reason | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Not a flood event | the loss is not direct physical loss by flood |
| No coverage on the date of loss | the date of loss falls outside the coverage period |
| Proof of loss not timely | the proof of loss was not received in time |
| Loss within attachment | the covered loss does not exceed the attachment point |
| Excluded property | the property is excluded |

The letter states that suit may be filed within the tier's suit limitation period in calendar months of the denial date and that a disagreement on the amount of loss may go to appraisal when the tier makes appraisal available.

A denial concerns one coverage on a claim and carries exactly one of the reasons above.
